jobs:
  debug-push-permissions:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout Code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '18'
          cache: 'npm'

      - name: Install Dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Debug Environment Details
        run: |
          echo "=== Environment Details ==="
          echo "Repository: ${{ github.repository }}"
          echo "Branch: ${{ github.ref }}"
          echo "Event: ${{ github.event_name }}"
          echo "Actor: ${{ github.actor }}"
          echo "SHA: ${{ github.sha }}"
          echo "Workflow: ${{ github.workflow }}"
          echo ""
          
          echo "=== Git Config ==="
          git config --global user.name "GitHub Actions"
          git config --global user.email "actions@github.com"
          git remote -v
          echo ""
          
          echo "=== Branch Protection Rules ==="
          curl -H "Authorization: Bearer ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}" \
               -H "Accept: application/vnd.github.v3+json" \
               "https://api.github.com/repos/${{ github.repository }}/branches/${{ github.ref_name }}/protection" || echo "No protection rules found or access denied"

      - name: Check Auth Status
        run: |
          echo "=== Authentication Status ==="
          echo "Token available: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN != '' }}"
          echo ""
          
          echo "=== Git Remote URL ==="
          git remote get-url origin
          echo ""
          
          echo "=== Current User ==="
          git config user.name
          git config user.email
          echo ""
          
          echo "=== Git Status ==="
          git status
          echo ""
          
          echo "=== Git Log ==="
          git log --oneline -5
          echo ""

      - name: Test Push Permission
        run: |
          echo "=== Testing Push Capability ==="
          # Create a test file
          echo "Test file for permission check" > test-push-permission.txt
          git add test-push-permission.txt
          git commit -m "Test commit for permission check"
          
          # Try to push (this will fail if no permission)
          echo "Attempting to push..."
          git push origin HEAD:${{ github.ref_name }} || echo "Push failed as expected - this is normal for debugging"
          
          # Clean up
          rm test-push-permission.txt
          git reset --hard HEAD~1
